name: CHARM
fullName: Intravenous Glibenclamide for Cerebral Oedema after Large Hemispheric Stroke
population: n=535, 18-85 (primary analysis restricted to 18-70), NIHSS large hemispheric infarction, study drug started within 10 h of onset
finding: Trial STOPPED EARLY for slow COVID-era enrolment before the planned sample was reached
teachingPoint: IV glibenclamide for large hemispheric infarction remains unproven — CHARM was halted early and underpowered.
